user.title: New agenda
user.description: One agenda per room or device. Events, repetitions and the devices it controls are set in the Agenda panel.

abort.already_configured: An agenda with this name already exists.

resync.name: Resynchronise
resync.description: Brings the devices controlled by the agenda back to the state it wants now.

skip_next.name: Skip the next occurrence
skip_next.description: Removes the next occurrence to start, of one event or of any event of the agenda.

event.name: Event
event.description: Event name. Leave empty for the next occurrence of any event.

add_dates.name: Add dates
add_dates.description: Adds occurrences of an event on these days, on top of its repetition.

event.name: Event
event.description: Event name (every event with this name).

remove_dates.name: Remove dates
remove_dates.description: Removes the occurrences of an event on these days.

event.name: Event
event.description: Event name (every event with this name).

set_absence.name: Start the absence mode
set_absence.description: Agendas that follow the absence mode keep their away state and run no action until it ends.

until.name: Until
until.description: End of the absence. Leave empty to stop it by hand.

end_absence.name: End the absence mode
end_absence.description: Agendas go back to their schedule.

advance.name: Skip to the next state
advance.description: Applies now the state the agenda would reach at its next change, until that time comes.

apply_event.name: Apply an event now
apply_event.description: Applies now the state of an event, until its next occurrence ends.

event.name: Event
event.description: Event name (the first one to come).

resume.name: Resume the schedule
resume.description: Ends the override, and takes back the devices changed by hand.

reset_learning.name: Reset the learning
reset_learning.description: Forgets the heating and cooling speeds learned by the agenda.

climate.name: Thermostat
climate.description: Only this thermostat. Leave empty for all of them.

not_applied.title: {entity} does not follow the agenda {agenda}
not_applied.description: Agenda sent {state} to {entity} twice, and the device still shows something else. Check that it is reachable and that it accepts this state (its limits, its modes). This notice goes away once the device follows the agenda again.
